reviews.author: Rose W
reviews.text: We broke down at a rest area in the middle of a long road trip and were in a pretty stressful situation. Mike came out initially for a roadside battery call, but quickly recognized the actual origin of the power concern. He diagnosed and verified the true issue, coordinated getting the necessary parts, and got everything installed efficiently. On top of that, he was incredibly friendly and easy to work with, which made a stressful situation so much better. Thanks to his professionalism and problem-solving, we were able to get safely back on the road. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Teresa Wiggins
reviews.text: Highly recommended!!!Michael was awesome..Was Very Helpful in the Early Morning. Came out 7am with no hesitation. Checked out got my truck and fixed it right on the spot..Service was Great!!Didn't even want to charge me anything... So if you need a vehicle towed or auto repair, All N One will get you right.

reviews.author: Michael Davis
reviews.text: The tow truck driver did a excellent job on towing my vehicle. I would highly recommend All - N - One Auto Repair & Towing Service.

reviews.author: Katina Hyman
reviews.text: The gentleman was very polite and considerate of the fact my wheel was hanging off, he came in a timely manner and got the job done! I really appreciate his services. I definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Dwight Cannon
reviews.text: Michael is the best. I was in a horrible situation miles and miles from my home. The GPS had Michael not close to the location he communicated really well. He did not get upset and had a positive attitude through out the entire job. I really needed his positive attitude because I was on the road for a few hours but Michael really help me get my mind off the negative experience j was having with AAA and other drivers. Thanks Michael keep doing what you

reviews.author: Stanley Davis
reviews.text: Had a belt beak on my front tire. Had a spare, a jack and lug wrench. Turns out it wasn't the correct jack or lug wrench that came with the vehicle. Mind you, 10:30 pm, side of hwy 64, wife and 3 kids in the van. I called several 24 hr. Tow services with no luck. Finally I got through to mister Mike with ALL-N-ONE AUTO REPAIR AND TOWING. He came out and took my spare to get air in it, returned and installed on my vehicle. Professional manner, polite, and very helpful. Appreciate you getting me and my family back home safely Mike!!!

reviews.author: Brooklynn Oxendine
reviews.text: Got locked out of car and he came and got us in the car in the matter of minutes… genuinely nice and humorous guy. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jonathan Turner
reviews.text: 5 out of 5 stars. Had to use this company through my insurance company on a Sunday at 10pm. I honestly can't think of a worse possible time to need a tow especially a tow thats an hour one way. Very reasonable prices, definitely out beat the competitors quotes and they allow ride-a-longs to the destination which is surprisingly rare after Covid. This company came through for me, had good conversations on the way to the destination, good people, good service. Thank you for the good experience, it's rare for me to want to leave a review unless I get what I pay for and this company far exceeded that.

reviews.author: David Manning
reviews.text: Michael provided great service in getting my broken down car to the shop. It was a long haul but he made sure the car was there on time.

reviews.author: Blonnell McIntosh
reviews.text: The owner picked my vehicle up in a timely manner. My vehicle was delivered as instructed. I would use their services again.

reviews.author: Jasmine Petras
reviews.text: I was stuck on the side of highway 64 and Mike came and got me within 20 min a towed me back to Greenville! Wonderful company would recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Danny Cutchin
reviews.text: This guy came out to help late at night when no one else could, saved my vacation as I was on the way to the beach. Highly recommend
